results: 1. smooth pursuit and saccades: opsoclonus - chaotic multidirectional saccades without intersaccadic intervals
2. paraneoplastic and autoimmune antibody panel (serum): unremarkable
3. CT chest / abdomen / pelvis (occult tumour): no tumour found - idiopathic rather than paraneoplastic
4. immunotherapy trial: IV methylprednisolone and IV immunoglobulin followed by oral prednisone; myoclonus and ataxia resolved and opsoclonus improved; about 80% back to baseline at three months
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Idiopathic (non-paraneoplastic, antibody-negative) autoimmune Opsoclonus-Myoclonus Syndrome
1. Paraneoplastic Opsoclonus-Myoclonus Syndrome (occult microscopic neoplasm not detected on initial CT imaging)
2. Post-infectious autoimmune Opsoclonus-Myoclonus Syndrome
3. Antibody-positive autoimmune Opsoclonus-Myoclonus Syndrome (associated with a neuronal surface antibody not included in the standard paraneoplastic panel)
